include_rule: Retain the release-stable identifier for every candidate model.
exclude_or_hold_rule: Exclude rows without a stable model identifier from any CRC subset.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN; do not substitute model name for identifier.

include_rule: Include only human cancer models after release-header verification.
exclude_or_hold_rule: Exclude non-human, non-cancer, or non-cell-line model types from the CRC dependency subset.
unknown_rule: HOLD when species or model type is absent or ambiguous.

candidate_release_fields: OncotreeLineage; OncotreePrimaryDisease; lineage/disease fields in the official model metadata
include_rule: Include when the authoritative disease annotation identifies colorectal/colorectal adenocarcinoma or an equivalent CRC disease term.
exclude_or_hold_rule: Do not include a model based only on a name fragment, organoid label, or unverified free text.
unknown_rule: HOLD for missing or conflicting lineage/disease annotations.

candidate_release_fields: OncotreeLineage; OncotreePrimaryDisease; model metadata release fields
include_rule: Retain the conflict for manual review and do not silently resolve it.
exclude_or_hold_rule: Exclude from an analyzed CRC subset until the conflict is resolved against the same pinned release.

include_rule: All filtering must record the exact DepMap release and source file used.
exclude_or_hold_rule: Do not combine model metadata from one release with dependency/omics data from another release.
unknown_rule: HOLD when release identity is unavailable.

include_rule: This contract may produce a candidate model list only after official headers and release terms are reviewed.
exclude_or_hold_rule: It does not authorize downloading, dependency scoring, gene ranking, or a CRC therapeutic conclusion.
unknown_rule: UNKNOWN until file-level catalog and headers are reviewed.
